$comment: Pinned on 2026-11-12 when the narration shipped for its first playtest, without a listening review: every take then in the manifests, filed by the first 16 hex digits of its clip key (tools/voice/manifest.ts). A re-render can never replace one silently. A take that does not hold up is replaced by editing its line (a new clip key) in a new change; its old key stays here until that change drops it.
